title: Termwise nilpotence for the canonical left Koszul unit
statement: Fix a prime $\ell$, a finite extension $E/\mathbf Q_\ell$, a scheme $T$, and the completed coefficient sheaf $R$ with uniformizer $\pi$. Let $C(P)=\mathsf R_j(L_j\otimes_R P)$ and $u_P:P\to C(P)$ be the specified left-Koszul completion and zero-homotopy unit [def-sp-power-torsion-limit-models]. There is a natural transformation $\eta:\mathrm{id}\to C$ on all strict unbounded $R$-complexes whose component at $P$ is $u_P$. For every such $P$ and every $r\geq1$ such that $\pi^r$ kills every section of every term of $P$, the chain map $u_P$ is a quasi-isomorphism. No outer tower or completeness assertion is part of this statement.

source.place: Completeness sentence, principal Koszul calculation and canonical quotient projections; Bhatt--Scholze, Lemmas 3.4.12 and 3.5.4--3.5.7.

proof.text: The pro-etale module category has exact countable products. Apply the generic nilpotent-action theorem with the completed coefficient sheaf and its uniformizer. Use its natural unit on all complexes and its nilpotent-action conclusion separately for each given exponent.

source.place: Completeness sentence, principal Koszul calculation and canonical quotient projections; Bhatt--Scholze, Lemmas 3.4.12 and 3.5.4--3.5.7.

proof.text: Transport the generic right tensor by the signed tensor symmetry. It sends the degree-zero inclusion x tensor 1 to 1 tensor x. Identify the two Roos functors as the same shifted mapping cone of one minus product shift; on maps their product maps and shifted cone maps agree. The coordinate normalization pins the transported map to u_P with zero homotopy. These identifications transport naturality and the quasi-isomorphism conclusion.

lean.statement:
theorem left_koszul_nilpotent_unit :
    ∃ η : 𝟭 (CochainComplex (integralTowerModules l E T) ℤ) ⟶ completion l E T,
      (∀ P, η.app P = unit l E T P) ∧
      ∀ (P : CochainComplex (integralTowerModules l E T) ℤ) (r : ℕ), 1 ≤ r →
        (∀ (a : ℤ) (U : T.ProEtᵒᵖ) (x : (P.X a).val.obj U),
          (@id ((completedIntegralCoefficientSheafUnrestricted l E T).obj.obj U)
            ((uniformizer l E T).val U)) ^ r • x = 0) →
        QuasiIso (unit l E T P)
